keywords: enterprise engaged in commercial, industrial or business activities
exclusion when activities are not commercial/industrial/business (e.g., collecting donations)
if any small proportion is commercial/industrial/business then AS applies to all activities
materiality of items (omission/misstatement affects economic decisions)
AS intended to apply only to material items
Income-tax vs accounting standards (expense in P&L not always tax deductible)
mandatory status implication for partnership firm (attest functions; adequate disclosures in reports)
Income Computation and Disclosure Standards: ICDS I-X (Accounting Policies to Provisions/Contingent items)
Companies classification into SMC and Non-SMC (Companies (Accounting Standards) Rules, 2021)
Non-SMC comply with all Accounting Standards in entirety
SMC relaxation/exemptions: AS 17 not applicable in entirety; partial relaxations for AS 15/AS 19/AS 20/AS 28/AS 29
Non-company revised criteria effective for periods commencing on/after April 1, 2024
Non-company entities: MSME vs Large (two levels)
MSME conditions: unlisted equity/debt; not bank/FI/insurance; turnover not exceeding Rs250 crore; borrowings not exceeding Rs50 crore; not holding/subsidiary of non-MSME
Large non-company entities comply in full with all AS
MSME: AS 3/AS 17/AS 20/AS 24 not applicable in their entirety
MSME partial non-application: AS 18 and AS 28 when turnover does not exceed Rs50 crore and borrowings do not exceed Rs10 crore and not holding/subsidiary of non-covered MSME
MSME disclosure on exemptions/relaxations (disclose MSME status + compliance; disclose standards where exemption availed)
typical_question_signals: Is Accounting Standard X applicable to this enterprise? (corporate vs non-company; charitable vs business activity)
Assess applicability based on materiality: whether an item should be shown separately rather than clubbed.
Classify the non-company entity as MSME or Large as per ICAI August 2024 criteria (turnover/borrowings/listing/bank-FI/insurance/holding-subsidiary).
Which AS are not applicable in their entirety / where exemptions apply for MSMEs or SMCs?
M1-C3-U0-T2.notes: Largely classification/theory: (i) whether AS applies to the enterprise/financial statements/material item, and (ii) classification-based exemptions/relaxations using explicit thresholds (SMC vs Non-SMC; MSME vs Large; MSME turnover Rs250cr/borrowings Rs50cr; AS18/AS28 partial-exemption thresholds turnover Rs50cr/borrowings Rs10cr - note these are DIFFERENT threshold pairs, easy to conflate, must be tested separately). Verified against source (2026-07-20) - every section number, AS list, and threshold pair confirmed exact, including the easily-confused 250cr/50cr vs 50cr/10cr distinction.
